name: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

meta.wiki: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

summary: In Thunder Bluff, Orm Stonehoof can forge the Brutal Helm. Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to him for the work.

sections.title: A Recommendation in Iron
sections.body: Warriors who prove their mettle and gather pieces of the Brutal Armor in the Barrens are sent to Thunder Bluff. Thun'grim Firegaze is a skilled armorsmith, but the work has grown beyond his craft. So he directs the warriors to Orm Stonehoof, whose skill is known across Kalimdor. Orm can shape sturdy helms from rare trophies taken from savage beasts.

sections.title: The Artisan by the Pool
sections.body: Orm Stonehoof lives and works on Mulgore's high bluffs, near the pool below Thunder Bluff's great central totem. When a warrior comes with Thun'grim Firegaze's word, Orm sets aside his usual work. He speaks with them about the demanding parts needed to forge a helm fit for the Horde's front lines.

faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof is a skilled tauren armorsmith who lives in Thunder Bluff. Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to him for his skill in forging battle helms.

faq.q: Where can Orm Stonehoof be found?
faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof works near the pool beneath Thunder Bluff's great central totem.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim Firegaze send you to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze can craft the chestpiece and other parts of the Brutal set, but Orm Stonehoof has the skill to forge the Brutal Helm.
The Brutal Helm is headgear forged for Horde warriors who have reached veteran standing. It requires dangerous materials from beasts across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What does Orm ask for next?
faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof asks you to gather beast trophies for the helm, beginning with a Chimaeric Horn from a wild chimaera.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. This line is for warriors advanced in their martial training who have completed Thun'grim's initial armor work.

angles.text: As a warrior, you are sent to one of the Horde's finest master smiths for heavy head protection.
As a member of the Horde, you see orcish weaponmasters in the Barrens working with tauren craftsmen high atop Thunder Bluff.
